items.title: Jackie Cain and Roy Kral interviewed by Monk Rowe, New York City, New York, March 22, 1998
items.q: He said that on his radio show when I did it with [sounds like] Loonis McLeun, the NPR show you know

ctx.x: And one time he said a thing about me that I’ll never forget. He said “when she sings a song it stays sung.” He said that on his radio show when I did it with [sounds like] Loonis McLeun, the NPR show you know, and that thrilled me that he would say that, because you know he doesn’t mess around, he doesn’t say nice things if he doesn’t mean them.
Why don’t we take a pause for just a second. It’s 4:30. I don’t know if you’re in a great hurry.
